prompt: Create a cute kawaii sticker-style illustration of a smiling potted cactus mascot on a transparent background, shown over a faint gray checkerboard transparency preview. The cactus is bright lime green, glossy, and vertically ribbed, with a large rounded central body and exactly 2 raised curved arms, one on each side. Give it a happy face with exactly 2 big black oval eyes with white highlights, 2 pink circular blush cheeks, and a wide open smiling mouth with a red interior and pink tongue. Add many small cream-colored starburst cactus spines with orange bases across the body and arms, keeping them cute rather than sharp. Place exactly 1 large flower on the upper left of the cactus head: coral red petals, yellow round stamens, and a dark green outline. Put the cactus in exactly 1 terracotta flower pot, warm orange with darker shading, glossy highlights, a thick rounded rim, and visible brown pebbles/soil along the top. Use a bold dark green/black outline around all major shapes plus a thick soft white sticker border around the entire character. Style should be polished vector-like digital art with soft gradients, shiny highlights, high saturation, rounded forms, centered composition, no text, no watermark, isolated asset suitable for web or sticker use. transparent checkerboard preview

promptZh: 创建一个可爱的卡哇伊风格贴纸插图，主体为一个在透明背景上微笑的盆栽仙人掌吉祥物，背景显示为淡淡的灰色棋盘格透明预览。仙人掌颜色为明亮的 青绿色，具有光泽感和垂直棱纹，拥有一个大的圆形中心躯干，两侧各有一只向上弯曲的手臂。为其添加一张开心的脸，包含 2 只带有白色高光的大型黑色椭圆形眼睛、2 个粉色圆形腮红，以及一个露出红色内里和粉色舌头的宽大微笑嘴巴。在身体和手臂上添加许多奶油色的小型星芒状仙人掌刺，底部为橙色，保持可爱而非尖锐的质感。在仙人掌头部的左上方放置 1 朵大花：珊瑚红 花瓣，黄色圆形雄蕊，以及深绿色轮廓。将仙人掌放置在 1 个陶土花盆中，花盆呈暖橙色，带有深色阴影、光泽高光、厚实的圆边，顶部可见棕色鹅卵石/土壤。在所有主要形状周围使用粗犷的深绿色/黑色轮廓，并在整个角色周围加上厚实的柔和白色贴纸边框。风格应为精致的矢量风格数字艺术，具有柔和的渐变、闪亮的高光、高饱和度、圆润的形态、居中构图，无文字，无水印，是适合网页或贴纸使用的独立素材。透明棋盘格预览
